statement: Discovery calls often turn into dynamic interrogations or robotic question checklists, annoying buyers and stalling conversations.
normalized_problem: Discovery calls feeling like interrogations rather than natural business conversations
desired_outcome: Conduct fluid, engaging conversations that extract deep buyer insights without making prospects feel questioned or defensive.
current_solutions: Qualification frameworks like BANT or MEDDIC
attempts: Deploying tactical empathy techniques from sales books
Asking granular technical or infrastructure questions straight away
solution_complaints: Reps stall when prospects push back or answer outside the script
Deep technical questioning can make executive buyers combative or defensive
